info.title: ingest-shim
info.summary: Authenticated, scope-guarded HTTPS front door that republishes SparkPlug JSON envelopes to RabbitMQ.
info.description:
Accepts one SparkPlug-derived JSON envelope per request from a client's Node-RED tee, checks the shared `X-Ingest-Key`, admits only envelopes whose group (first topic segment) equals the configured scope (SCOPE_GROUP, default `INCOPLAST`, compared case-insensitively), and publishes it to RabbitMQ (exchange EXCHANGE default `oee`, routing key ROUTING_KEY default `sparkplug.data`) with publisher confirms (CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS, default 5000). The envelope is republished once per configured flow (FANOUT_SOURCE_TYPES, default `legacy,go,refactored` -> `source_type` "", "go", "refactored"); a failure on any copy returns 503 so the tee retries the whole message (all downstream writers are idempotent).

Transport: the listener is TLS-only (`ListenAndServeTLS`, HTTP_ADDR default `:8444`), with the certificate mounted at /certs. Prometheus metrics are on a separate plaintext listener (METRICS_ADDR, default `:9105`).

Public exposure: none. No nginx vhost routes to this service on staging or production. Staging publishes the port on the host loopback only (127.0.0.1:8444). Production defines the service behind the `client-ingest` compose profile and publishes 8444 on all host interfaces, but the production security group does not admit 8444. The servers below are in-network addresses.

Ops route not described here: `GET /healthz` (200 `{"status":"ok"}`, or 503 `{"status":"amqp_down"}`).

## How to call this API

- **Auth**: send the shared ingest key in the `X-Ingest-Key` header (server env INGEST_API_KEY; the service refuses to start without one). Compared in constant time and never logged. Ask the platform team for the key of the target environment.
- **Base URLs**: see `servers`; both are in-network only (packiot-net or the host loopback), there is no public URL. TLS with the stack's mounted certificate (`curl -k` against localhost).
- **Content types**: request `application/json`, one JSON object per request, at most MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB). Responses are `application/json`, except the router's own 405 which is `text/plain`.
- **Errors**: `{"error":"<message>"}` (application/json, no trailing newline) with a stable message per cause; see each response. 400/401/403 are permanent (fix the request); 503 is retryable (resend the same envelope).
- **Docs**: browse this spec in the API docs portal https://api.staging.packiot.app/docs/ (cs-admin SSO, read-only Swagger UI). The spec is also exported to `docs/api/openapi/ingest-shim.openapi.json` in packiot-stack-alpha.

servers.description: In-network on packiot-net (staging and production: static IP 172.18.0.29:8444). TLS with the stack's mounted certificate.
Local development (`make dev SVC=ingest-shim`; self-signed dev cert, use curl -k)

tags.name: ingest
tags.description: Push SparkPlug-derived JSON envelopes from a client's factory tee into the platform's RabbitMQ data path (one envelope per request).

post.description:
Admits one envelope from the client's tee and republishes it to RabbitMQ.

Order of checks: route/method (405, router) -> API key (401) -> body read under MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB; over the cap, unreadable or empty -> 400) -> group extraction (400 when the body is not a JSON object, a probed field is not a string, or no topic/group is found) -> scope check (403) -> fan-out publish (503 on any broker failure).

Group extraction: the first `/`-separated segment of, in order, `topic`, `group`, `group_id`, then each `metrics[].name`; the first non-empty one wins. It must equal SCOPE_GROUP (case-insensitive).

Side effects: one AMQP message per FANOUT_SOURCE_TYPES entry (default 3) on exchange `oee` / routing key `sparkplug.data`, each the original object with a top-level `source_type` set ("" = legacy flow, "go", "refactored"; any `source_type` you send is overwritten). The downstream worker routes each copy to its flow's tables (raw equipment values/events). Nothing is written to a database by this service.

Idempotency and retries: 202 means every copy was broker-confirmed. On 503 some copies may already be published; resend the same envelope (downstream writes are idempotent upserts, so duplicates do not double-count). No rate limit is enforced here.

Tenant scoping: one scope group per instance; the key is shared by that client's tee only.

requestBody.description: One SparkPlug-derived JSON object (as produced by the tee's SparkPlug JSON decode). Forwarded verbatim apart from `source_type`. Examples assume SCOPE_GROUP=ACME.

metricsOnly.summary: No topic: group taken from the first metric name

202.description: Every fan-out copy was confirmed by the broker.

400.description: Permanent request problem (do not retry unchanged): `payload too large` (body over MAX_BODY_BYTES; note 400, not 413), `cannot read body` (read error, e.g. client disconnect), `empty body`, `unparseable or topicless payload` (not a JSON object, a probed field has the wrong type, or no group can be found), or `unparseable payload (fanout)` (defensive: re-marshal failed after admission).

noGroup.summary: Not a JSON object, or no topic/group anywhere

403.description: `out-of-scope group`: the envelope's group (first topic segment) is not the configured SCOPE_GROUP. The rejected group is logged server-side, not echoed.

405.description: Method other than POST on this path. Answered by Go's ServeMux before authentication, with an `Allow: POST` header and a plain-text body.

schema.description: Go net/http reason phrase plus newline.

503.description: `publish failed`: the broker nacked, did not confirm within CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS, or the connection is down, for at least one copy. Earlier copies may already be published. Retry the whole message.

ingestKey.name: X-Ingest-Key
ingestKey.description: Shared ingest key (INGEST_API_KEY), compared in constant time. Never logged.

SparkplugEnvelope.description: A JSON object from the tee. The shim reads only the fields below to find the group (first `/`-separated segment, tried in order: `topic`, `group`, `group_id`, then each `metrics[].name`); all other fields pass through untouched to the downstream worker. If any of these fields is present with a non-string type the body is rejected (400). Any existing top-level `source_type` is overwritten per fan-out copy.

topic.description: SparkPlug topic; its first segment is the group.

group.description: Explicit group (first segment used), tried when `topic` is empty.

group_id.description: SparkPlug group id, tried when `topic` and `group` are empty.

source_type.description: Ignored on input: overwritten on every fan-out copy.

metrics.description: SparkPlug metrics; passed through. Names are tried for the group when no topic/group field is set.

name.description: Metric name; may be a full topic path whose first segment is the group.

error.description: Stable error message; see the response descriptions.
